issues.legal_issue: A civil suit for redemption is not subject to the one-year limitation period for setting aside an officer’s order when the officer merely declines summary jurisdiction and relegates the parties to a civil suit without deciding the redemption claim.
material_facts: The claimants applied for redemption under the statutory summary procedure.
The officer rejected the application because it raised complicated questions of fact and law that could not be tried summarily, and directed the claimants to file a civil suit.
The officer did not decide the merits of the claimants’ right to redeem.
The claimants later filed a civil suit seeking redemption, and the defendants argued that it was barred because it was not brought within one year of the officer’s order.
issues.conclusion: The civil suit for redemption was not barred by limitation; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 4, 9 and 12 of the Redemption of Mortgages (Punjab) Act, 1913, an officer’s order dismissing a summary application for a ground within section 9 may be subject to a suit to establish rights under section 12. Article 14 of Schedule I to the Limitation Act, 1908 applies to a suit seeking to set aside an officer’s order, not to a suit for redemption where the officer merely refers the parties to a civil court without deciding against the mortgagor. The substance, not the form, of the order determines whether it must be set aside. The Court followed Tulsi Das v. Diala Ram and Dewan Chand v. Raghbir Singh.

rule.if: redemption_suit and summary_application_referred_to_civil_court and no_merits_decision_against_mortgagor and suit_seeks_redemption_not_annulment

predicates.redemption_suit: A party brings a civil suit seeking redemption of a mortgage.
predicates.summary_application_referred_to_civil_co: An officer handling a summary redemption application declines to try it summarily and directs the applicant to pursue the matter in a civil court.
predicates.no_merits_decision_against_mortgagor: The officer does not decide the merits of the applicant’s right to redeem.
predicates.suit_seeks_redemption_not_annulment: The civil suit seeks redemption and does not seek to set aside the officer’s order.
predicates.redemption_suit_not_barred_by_order_base: The civil suit for redemption is not barred by the limitation period for setting aside an officer’s order.

issues.definition: When a party brings a civil suit for redemption after an officer refers a summary application to the civil court without deciding the redemption claim, and the suit seeks redemption rather than annulment of the order, the suit is not barred by the limitation period for setting aside an officer’s order.
